text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the
equipment inspection, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1
in the title block for Battery Charger:
Model 
 :ARF130SE12
AC 
input :380 V ,
10 A, 50 HZ, 1 PH
DC
output :129-140V,
12A
No of 
cells: 56
The first draft initiated by Eng Metwaly Mahmoud El_Sayed 
El_Hendawy and revised by 
Operation and maintenance's General Director: eng Mohamed Reda Abd El-Azez
Safety Precautions
Work order must be issued.
Switch off input & output supply
Tools and Equipment
Suitable Tool Set
Digital Voltmeter
Vacuum Cleaner or Blower
Brush
Work to be Carried Out
Switch off input and output supply.
Clean from dust deposits, dust of heat 
 radiating surface.
Check area around charger should be clean.
Inspect over heating compartment of control board.
Inspect visually for Scr's and Diodes.
Connections at the terminals should be clean, tithing.
Switch on input and output supply.
Check float and equalize voltage.
Check the current limit operation.
Check input and output voltage.
